note: NASA hardware on the surface of Mars. Dates and wording come from the cited science.nasa.gov mission pages. Positions are rounded NSSDCA landing coordinates (packages/shared NASA_MARS_LANDINGS) unless basis says otherwise; rovers that drove away are shown at their landing site, not their final position. Perseverance uses its latest published PDS PLACES localization.

items.name: Viking 1 lander
items.whySilent: Stopped operating after getting a faulty command.

items.name: Viking 2 lander
items.whySilent: Continued to transmit data until April 12, 1980.

items.name: Sojourner rover
items.whySilent: Deployed by the Pathfinder lander; the mission ended Sept. 27, 1997.

items.name: Spirit rover
items.whySilent: Became stuck in soft soil on May 1, 2009; no contact after March 22, 2010; NASA declared the mission complete on May 25, 2011.

items.name: Opportunity rover
items.whySilent: Stopped communicating after a severe Mars-wide dust storm blanketed its location; last signal June 10, 2018.

items.name: Phoenix lander
items.whySilent: End of mission: Nov. 2, 2008, in the arctic plains of Vastitas Borealis.

items.name: Ingenuity helicopter
items.whySilent: Flew for the last time on Jan. 18, 2024, and completed its mission on Jan. 25, 2024, after 72 flights.
